```{python}
#| context: setup
import sys
import re
from pathlib import Path

from shiny import reactive, render
from shiny import ui
from shinywidgets import render_plotly

HERE = Path.cwd().resolve()
PROJECT_ROOT = HERE if (HERE / "quarto_visualizer").exists() else HERE.parent
if str(PROJECT_ROOT) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(PROJECT_ROOT))

from quarto_visualizer.app_state import find_config_path, load_app_state
from quarto_visualizer.plots import make_bar_figure, make_density_figure
from quarto_visualizer.quarto_shell import (
    destination_average_table,
    destination_frames,
    destination_purpose_choices,
    joint_tour_composition_frames,
    joint_tour_frequency_frames,
    joint_tour_party_size_frames,
    joint_tours_hhsize_frames,
    long_term_auto_frames,
    long_term_geo_flow_frames,
    long_term_geo_choices,
    long_term_mandatory_length_frames,
    long_term_telecommute_frames,
    long_term_tlfd_frames,
    long_term_wfh_frames,
    overview_hh_size_frames,
    overview_kpi_cards,
    overview_percent_diff_table,
    overview_person_type_frames,
    run_frame_tabs,
    stop_frequency_frames,
    stop_frequency_purpose_choices,
    stop_location_all_frames,
    stop_location_purpose_choices,
    stop_location_purpose_frames,
    stop_purpose_frames,
    stop_timing_frames,
    stop_timing_purpose_choices,
    tour_mode_detail_frames,
    tour_mode_grouped_frames,
    tour_mode_purpose_choices,
    tour_summary_dap_frames,
    tour_summary_indiv_nm_frames,
    tour_summary_mtf_frames,
    tour_summary_ptype_values,
    tour_tod_frames,
    tour_tod_purpose_choices,
    trip_mode_frames,
    trip_mode_purpose_choices,
    trip_mode_tour_mode_choices,
)

CONFIG_PATH = find_config_path()
APP_STATE = load_app_state(CONFIG_PATH)
WEIGHTED_BUNDLE = APP_STATE.bundles.weighted
RUN_COLORS = APP_STATE.config.run_colors
TOUR_SUMMARY_PTYPE_VALUES = tour_summary_ptype_values(WEIGHTED_BUNDLE)
TOUR_SUMMARY_PTYPE_LABEL_MAP = {
    p: ("Total" if str(p) == "Total" else APP_STATE.config.ptype_label(p))
    for p in TOUR_SUMMARY_PTYPE_VALUES
}
TOUR_SUMMARY_LABEL_TO_PTYPE = {label: p for p, label in TOUR_SUMMARY_PTYPE_LABEL_MAP.items()}
TOUR_SUMMARY_PTYPE_DISPLAY_CHOICES = [TOUR_SUMMARY_PTYPE_LABEL_MAP[p] for p in TOUR_SUMMARY_PTYPE_VALUES]
TOUR_SUMMARY_PTYPE_DEFAULT = (
    "Total" if "Total" in TOUR_SUMMARY_PTYPE_DISPLAY_CHOICES else TOUR_SUMMARY_PTYPE_DISPLAY_CHOICES[0]
)
STOP_LOCATION_PURPOSES = stop_location_purpose_choices(WEIGHTED_BUNDLE)


def _safe_output_id(prefix: str, value: str) -> str:
    slug = re.sub(r"[^0-9A-Za-z_]+", "_", str(value)).strip("_").lower()
    return f"{prefix}_{slug}" if slug else prefix
```

# {.sidebar}

## Runs Loaded

```{python}
for idx, run in enumerate(WEIGHTED_BUNDLE.runs):
    color = APP_STATE.config.run_color(idx)
    ui.div(
        ui.HTML(
            f"<div style='padding:8px 10px;border-left:4px solid {color};"
            f"margin:6px 0;border-radius:6px;background:rgba(127,127,127,0.06)'>"
            f"<b style='color:{color}'>{run.label}</b><br>"
            f"<span style='font-size:12px;color:#666'>{run.run_dir}</span></div>"
        )
    )
```

## Display Options

```{python}
ui.input_radio_buttons("weight_mode", "Weighting", choices=["Weighted", "Unweighted"], selected="Weighted")
ui.input_radio_buttons("value_mode", "Values", choices=["Percent", "Count"], selected="Percent")
```

```{python}
@reactive.calc
def current_bundle():
    return APP_STATE.bundles.weighted if input.weight_mode() == "Weighted" else APP_STATE.bundles.unweighted


@reactive.calc
def current_long_term_geo():
    if APP_STATE.config.geography_enabled:
        return input.long_term_geo()
    return "Total"


@reactive.calc
def current_tour_summary_ptype():
    return TOUR_SUMMARY_LABEL_TO_PTYPE.get(input.tour_summary_ptype(), input.tour_summary_ptype())
```

```{python}
for purpose in STOP_LOCATION_PURPOSES:
    output_id = _safe_output_id("stop_location", purpose)
    ui.markdown(f"### {purpose}")

    def _plot_stop_location(purpose=purpose):
        return make_density_figure(
            stop_location_purpose_frames(current_bundle(), purpose),
            x_col="distbin",
            y_col="freq",
            title=f"Stop Out-of-Direction Distance - {purpose}",
            xaxis_title="Miles",
            normalize=True,
            value_mode=input.value_mode(),
            run_colors=RUN_COLORS,
        )

    _plot_stop_location.__name__ = output_id
    render_plotly(_plot_stop_location)
```
